select
,etrAdd.trade_id tradeId,etrAdd.request_id requestId,finProduct.FINPROD_MARKET_ID repSecId ,etrPle.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE pledgeFaceValue,etrPle.PLEDGE_NUMBER pledgeNumber,etrPle.PLEDGE_RATIO pledgeRatio ,etrPle.PLEDGE_AMT pledgeAmt ,etrAdd.TERM_DAYS termDays,etr.COUNTER_ID counterId ,etr.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader ,etrAdd.TRADER trader,etrAdd.COUNTER_CON_NO counterConNo ,etrAdd.COUNTER_SEAT counterSeat ,etr.REMARK remark,etrAdd.BUSI_PS busiPs from ETR_ENTRUST etr left join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD etrAdd on etrAdd.ENTRUST_ID = etr.ENTRUST_ID left join ETR_PLEDGE etrPle on etrPle.ENTRUST_ID = etr.ENTRUST_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT finProduct on finProduct.FINPROD_ID = etrPle.FINPROD_ID where etr.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
